messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD-INC-4721: inference-runtime > 95% latency (prod-east-1). page_targets: @maya (primary), @samir (secondary)
pagerduty: PD Incident PD-INC-4721 created. Escalation policy: inference-prod. TTL: 5m.
maya: ack. looking
maya: not seeing errors in the runtime pods yet, pulling logs now
samir: i got the escalation, on my way (in 10m). pinging if need urgent.
pagerduty: PD-INC-4721: Primary did not acknowledge within 5m; escalating to secondary (@samir).
samir: ack. taking ownership. what’s the customer impact?
incident-bot: Incident metadata: service=inference-runtime, region=prod-east-1, symptom=token-generation latency spikes, %requests>500ms=48%, errors=2.3%
ashley: noticed a spike in 503 from the routing layer ~2m ago. Might be an autoscaler thrash?
samir: checking controller metrics. running: `kubectl -n inference-prod get hpa`
(slight pause)
maya: heads-up, I did a quick grep and found repeated: "kv cache miss" lines in worker logs. posting snippet:
```
2026-03-14T02:14:03Z worker-3 inference INFO kv cache miss shard=12 key=0x7a... latency 12ms
2026-03-14T02:14:04Z worker-3 inference WARN attention kernel slower-than-expected seq_len=1024
```
samir: interesting. if KV cache cold it can spike latency. service was redeployed earlier w/ new model-variant? who rolled last?
maya: rollout by infra-carry yesterday to model:v3-quant for cost testing. no canary though.
ashley: hmm that would explain sudden memory/kv layout differences. can we fallback to model:v2 for traffic?
samir: quick mitigation: route prod-east-1 traffic to fallback pool that runs model:v2. I'll trigger switchover in the router config and scale down warmup to avoid capacity hole.
dmitri (manager): woke up by PD escalation, I’m here. any customer-facing impact right now?
maya: several customers hitting interactive endpoints have timeouts. SLO error budget at risk but not wholesale outage. top-tier customer X experiencing degraded latency for inference-chat route.
samir: executing rollback plan. command: `infra-router swap-backend --service=inference-chat --from=pool-v3 --to=pool-v2 --region=prod-east-1 --dry-run=false`
(some seconds)
samir: started swapping backends. adding buffer nodes: `k scale deploy inference-runtime-v2 --replicas=6 -n inference-prod`
incident-bot: PagerDuty note appended: mitigation step initiated by @samir.
pagerduty: PD-INC-4721: Secondary acknowledged. Escalation timer paused.
maya: after routing change, we're seeing 200s come back for a subset. 95th p50 improving.
ashley: will keep an eye on autoscaler chatter. can someone run `kubectl get pods -o wide -n inference-prod`? I'm seeing some CrashLoopBackOff on worker-7
samir: logs from worker-7 show OOMKilled. maybe v3-quant increased memory usage under certain prefixes. working on diag.
maya: @dmitri we should evaluate whether to rollback v3-quant in all regions and schedule formal canary next time.
dmitri (manager): yes, please capture postmortem actions. for now prioritize customer impact and full recovery.
pagerduty: PD-INC-4721: No ack from manager required. Manager escalation path not fired.
(3m later)
samir: traffic stable on v2 fallback. error rate down to 0.4%, latency back under SLO for most routes. still some traces with longer tails — tracking.
maya: logging a temporary post-incident note in #incidents: cause likely KV cache layout incompatibility with model:v3-quant; mitigation: route to v2 and scale memory for affected pods.
dmitri (manager): good job on the swift fallback. questions for postmortem: why was TTL for primary ack hit (maya had acked earlier but PD escalated), and why did we roll v3 without a cross-region canary?
maya: i did ack initially but slack->PD race: my ACK came after PD's TTL expired due to timezone mismatch on PD agent? need to correlate.
ashley: noted. i'll open an infra ticket to align monitoring clocks and PD agent sync. also add a step: model variant rollouts must include kv-cache warmup hook.
samir: handing off to maya for post-incident write-up and next steps. i'll stay on call for 10m for any followups.
maya: taking handoff. will compile timeline, attach logs, and propose rollout checklist updates.
incident-bot: PD-INC-4721 status changed to: monitoring.
dmitri (manager): if anyone sees regression, page again. otherwise we'll schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow morning. thanks team. :thumbsup:
